Kojève spent most of his life in France and from 1933 to 1939 delivered a series of lectures in Paris on Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel's work Phenomenology of Spirit. Kojève died in 1968, shortly after giving a talk to civil servants and state representatives for the European Economic Community in Brussels on behalf of the French government.
